==Description==
The '''Fleshling''' is an enemy that appears in [[Polluted Wasteland II]]. It is an enemy that is introduced naturally on Wave 15, preceding the appearance of the [[Amalgamation]] within the same wave. After Wave 15, it only spawns when the [[Amalgamation]] takes damage. It has low health, but is slightly fast and always spawns in groups.

==Appearance==
The '''Fleshling''' is a humanoid with a light red skin color. It has a bear trap fitted around its head and it has multiple clumps of flesh and smaller humanoids sticking out of its body.

==Strategy==
*High DPS towers, such as the [[Ranger]], [[Pursuit]] or [[Engineer]] are recommended to take down this enemy.
**All the listed towers also receive splash damage capabilities at certain Levels, making them able to damage multiple '''Fleshlings''' at once.
**The [[Accelerator]] can also be quite powerful against '''Fleshlings''' , though do note that it might lock on the [[Amalgamation]] causing the '''Fleshlings''' to slip by.
*Since multiple of them spawn at once, towers that can damage multiple enemies like the [[Golden Pyromancer]], [[Mortar]] or [[Electroshocker]] can be good at dealing with groups of '''Fleshlings'''.

==Trivia==
*The '''Fleshling''', despite never being intended to appear in a server with more than four players, has [[MEGA Servers]] health scaling. It increases its health by 150 for every player after 4 players.
**Due to 150 being close to as much as its regular health, its health is basically doubled in five player servers and tripled in six player servers.
**This is most likely carried over from the original [[Amalgamation (Polluted Wasteland)|Amalgamation]], which also increased its health by 150.
